newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Karadzic barred as voter in Bosnia elections.
newsitem.headline: Karadzic barred as voter in Bosnia elections.

text.p: International organisers on Tuesday banned former Bosnian Serb president Radovan Karazic, an indicted war criminal, from voting in Bosnia's local elections in September.
The Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) office in Bosnia said Karadzic had tried to trick an election supervisor into adding his name to the electoral register.

OSCE-Bosnia mission chief Robert Frowick refused to accept Karadzic's registration and also barred all other people indicted by the International War Crimes Tribunal on former Yugoslavia, based in The Hague, from voting in the election.

Karadzic signed a pledge when he was forced from power a year ago by international pressure not to participate in any elections in Bosnia, where Serbs, Moslems and Croats signed a U.S.-brokered peace treaty in December 1995 to end 43 months of war.
